description:
**Extraction (sibling — mirror canonical .1).** Move `MemoryBackend` from `crate-jmap-filenode-server/tests/common/mod.rs` (673 LOC) to a public, feature-gated reference implementation in `src/memory.rs`.

Mirror the canonical pattern landed by .1 (jmap-mail-server): same module name (`memory`), same type names (`MemoryBackend`, `MemoryState`), same feature flag (`"memory"`), same documentation idiom.

## Mechanical steps

1. Create `crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs` and move the contents of `tests/common/mod.rs`.
2. Add `[features] memory = []` to Cargo.toml. Gate `pub mod memory;` in lib.rs.
3. Rewrite `tests/common/mod.rs` as test-side helpers only (expected ≤ 200 LOC).
4. Add `[dev-dependencies] jmap-filenode-server = { workspace = true, features = ["memory"] }`.

Any divergence from .1's pattern is a regression. If a divergence seems necessary, stop and escalate.

## Acceptance

- `cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server --features memory` clean.
- `cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server` clean.
- `cargo check -p jmap-filenode-server --no-default-features` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-filenode-server --features memory --tests -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo doc -p jmap-filenode-server --features memory --no-deps` clean.
- `tests/common/mod.rs` ≤ 200 LOC of helpers.
- Naming exactly matches the canonical (.1).

## Depends on

JMAP-hwdv.1 (mail-server canonical). Cannot start until .1 lands.
